name: Bounded Continuation Persistence Counterexample Stress Domains

stress_domains.name: Near-Budget Boundary Domain
stress_domains.purpose: Test persistence behavior when C_A approaches, equals, and exceeds B_local(alpha).

stress_domains.name: Topology Severance Sensitivity Domain
stress_domains.purpose: Stress topology accessibility thresholds and preserve known divergence hotspots.

stress_domains.name: Identity Fragmentation Domain
stress_domains.purpose: Force bounded continuity classes to split and verify branch ambiguity is preserved.

stress_domains.name: Reconstruction Divergence Domain
stress_domains.purpose: Generate incompatible admissible histories and block unique persistence claims.

stress_domains.name: Channel Destabilization Domain
stress_domains.purpose: Test perturbation-driven channel collapse, bifurcation, and degradation.

stress_domains.name: Oscillatory Non-Stabilization Domain
stress_domains.purpose: Verify active continuation does not automatically imply bounded persistence.
